name: Vonage
description: Vonage offers communications APIs for messaging, voice, video, verification and network features.
auth_notes: Sources state JWT authentication is available; other outbound credential types are not described. Credentials come from the Vonage API Dashboard.
gate_detail: Developers create a free account and get first API credentials from the dashboard. Pricing and any paid usage requirements are not described in the sources; no sandbox stated.
api_scope: Video, Voice, Messaging (including RCS and WhatsApp), Verify, Number Insight, Fraud Defender, network features and an Account API, with client and server SDKs.
mcp_notes: Sources do not mention an MCP server.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate stated in the sources; pricing is not detailed.

evidence.quote: New to the Dashboard? Start here to learn the basics, navigate the interface, and get your first API credentials.
Vonage Messaging APIs are easy to set up and allow you to engage your customers via a diverse assortment of messaging channels.

issues: Auth is only stated as JWT availability; API key or Basic auth not described.
Pricing and paid requirements not shown.
No sandbox or MCP information in sources.
